      "name": "rpc",
      "member": true,
      "evidence": "Carries the RPC/REST/ZMQ label and adds `setprunelock` and `listprunelocks` to `src/rpc/blockchain.cpp`.",
      "band": "P2",
      "score": 0.6,
      "reason_tag": "new feature",
      "rationale": "Adds RPC endpoints that resolve a clear gap for downstream wallets and external indexers operating on pruned nodes. Reviewers note this enables external indexers and wallets to retain blocks needed for rescans without disabling pruning entirely."
    },
    {
      "name": "tests",
      "member": false,

      "band": "Unranked",
      "score": 0.0,
      "reason_tag": "test coverage",
      "rationale": "Feature tests that pin the behavior of a specific new RPC belong to that feature area rather than test infrastructure."
    },
    {
      "name": "utils",
      "member": false,
      "evidence": "Touches `src/init.cpp` only to register the `-prunelockheight` startup argument.",
      "band": "Unranked",
      "score": 0.0,
      "reason_tag": "cleanup",
      "rationale": "Argument handling changes whose purpose belongs specifically to block pruning and RPC functionality do not make it a utilities change."
    },
    {
      "name": "validation",
      "member": false,
